name: The end is never The end
source:
"The end is never the end" I read as I board the train, setting foot on the enigma she left for me. Please wait! Wait for me at the end of the end.

[i]Sara... Sara... Sara...
Thou naive child.
This train won't take you to any end.
It won't take you anywhere yet to me.
Haven't you realized that you're all alone?
Take my deal.
Converge into the darkness for the last time.
Grab my hand and claim the reminiscence.
As that is thy desire.[/i]

[From [url=https://purechito.itch.io/the-end-is-never-the-end]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当我登上火车，踏上她留给我的谜团时，我读到了“结局永远不是结局”。请稍等！在最后的尽头等我。

[i]萨拉…萨拉…萨拉…
你这个天真的孩子。
这列火车不会带你到任何终点。
它不会带你去任何地方。
难道你没有意识到你是孤独的吗？
接受我的交易。
最后一次融入黑暗。
抓住我的手，索取回忆。
因为那是你的愿望。[/i]

[来自[url=https://purechito.itch.io/the-end-is-never-the-end]itch.io[/url]]
